items.html:
(to the question) The five unclean bloods
Bloods mean the phases of coarseness included in the Malchut of ZA, which are Hod, Yesod, Malchut, that were not clarified and corrected in the inclusion of the coupling of pregnancy, but only from the phase of their root alone; hence they are still considered waste and bloods without clarification. Now, within this coarseness of Hod there are two phases: the first, that which belongs to the Nukva within the body of ZA, called the five Hassadim, and these are the five pure bloods, for they do not come out with the birth, but remain in its mother's womb, and slowly, in the order of the degree, they ascend to the HGT of Ima, where the coupling of phase 1 is, which brings out the level of the five Hassadim, and the coarseness is included in that screen of Ima, and from there ZA nurses them in the phase of milk. And that milk, which is the coarseness corrected in the screen, descends into ZA, and is again turned within it into clear, refined, and clarified blood — as is known, meaning that he too can couple upon them and attain the level of Hassadim, according to the quantity and quality that came out upon them, in the inclusion of the coupling in Ima. Thus the five bloods of the phase of the Nukva within the body of ZA, included in the coarseness of Hod, Yesod, and Malchut that were not clarified in pregnancy, are the phase of completely pure blood, for they turn and become the five Hassadim, which are the level of ZA.
